what: A sleep was put into user/src/bin/shell.rs between sys::spawn and drop(image), and the test suite was run in three stages. The sleep was removed afterwards; the shell in the repository does not have it.

stages.1-shell-delay-old-fuzzer: fuzzer and self-test as they were: both fail
stages.2-shell-delay-corrected-fuzzer: fuzzer sleeps before its first reading: fuzzer passes, self-test's last subtest fails
stages.3-shell-delay-both-corrected: both sleep before their first reading: the run passes
